audit_items.proof_trace: The property seized_value <= bad_debt_covered requires liquidation_incentive == 0 for ADL collateral ops. handle_collateral_auto_deleverage sets liquidation_incentive = collateral_params.liquidation_incentive(activation_time).min(max_liquidation_incentive) (L657), where liquidation_incentive = liquidation_incentive_base + daily_penalty * days (adl.move:201-206). new_adl_params (entry_points/admin/adl.move:60-61) validates only liquidation_factor_base_bps and close_factor_bps; liquidation_incentive_base_bps is unconstrained (no assert == 0), allowing any positive value. With non-zero incentive, seize_amount = repay * (1 + incentive) * price_debt / price_collateral (market.move:1058-1063), so seized_value > bad_debt_covered, violating the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An admin holding AdminCap calls new_adl_params with liquidation_incentive_base_bps=500 (5%), then enable_collateral_adl; the whitelisted ADLOperator calls liquidate_adl_deposit and receives 1.05x the repaid debt value in seized collateral, extracting 5% excess value from borrowers' collateral beyond the bad debt covered.
